The shipment includes battery modules, packaged lubricants, clinic coolers, and boxed repair parts. Loading starts at 0800 and the carrier accepts the completed load at 1600. Before I approve the final container plan and any handling controls, I need each of you to walk me through your recommendations for container assignment and any special handling requirements for your respective areas. Who wants to start?
